items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: That boy was crazy about me and I liked him.

ctx.x: You don't remember any white boys that ever sat in with you and anything? Well, yeah.

They had a boy named Jogan Duffy. Well, he couldn't play that, you know, but he would learn how to play trumpets. You know, I'd make him sit right side of me in the band and play along with me and dance and things, you know. But Joe never did learn I don't think. I haven't seen him since I left, since I've been back. I know he's an old man like I am now. See I was so good with him because he'd follow us everywhere, everywhere we went. Joe would go and his dad had a big market out there on Chippewa and something…
Many other guys like that, did you remember all of them?
